problem_statement: TailGrids play-tailwind is a runnable static Tailwind CSS multi-page marketing site (index/about/pricing/contact/blog/signin/signup pages plus a shared sticky navbar and footer). Its Awesome Pricing Plan section — three plan cards (Starter, Basic and the Recommended Basic, and Premium), each showing a dollar amount and a Per Month label — appears on BOTH the home page and the dedicated pricing page. The marketing team wants shoppers to compare monthly versus annual cost in place, so the task is to add a native billing-period control to that pricing section: a Monthly / Yearly toggle placed directly above the plan cards, with a live readout line and prices that switch between the monthly and the discounted annual figures. (1) Add the billing toggle to the pricing section with a Monthly button and a Yearly button, a readout that reads 'Billing: Monthly · pay as you go' by default, and the three plan amounts wired so they and the readout update when a period is chosen. (2) Because the pricing section is shared, the SAME billing control must render on the pricing section wherever it appears — on the home page (plan-billing--home) AND on the pricing page (plan-billing--pricing) — so the control is consistent cross-page, not only on the home page. (3) Style the control to match the Play blue-accent SaaS design system with a rounded pill toggle and keep the plan-card grid stable, with no horizontal overflow and no overlapping or illegible cards at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile. (4) Wire the interaction so that clicking Yearly updates the readout to 'Billing: Yearly · save 20%' and swaps every plan amount to its annual price; clicking Monthly restores the monthly figures. Preserve every existing page, the hero, feature/pricing/team/contact sections, Blog route, Sign In, Sign Up, local assets and the mobile navbar toggler. Implement in source HTML/CSS/JS only; do not add dependencies, generated screenshots or a detached bespoke page.
required_content: Add a billing-period toggle (Monthly / Yearly buttons, class plan-billing__btn with data-billing) directly above the three plan cards in the Awesome Pricing Plan section.
Show a live readout line (class plan-billing__readout, id plan-billing-readout) that reads 'Billing: Monthly · pay as you go' by default and 'Billing: Yearly · save 20%' after choosing Yearly.
Wire the toggle so clicking Yearly updates the readout AND swaps every plan amount to its annual price, and clicking Monthly restores the monthly figures; the clicked button becomes the active pill.

Render the SAME billing control on the pricing section on BOTH the home page (wrapper class plan-billing--home) AND the pricing page (wrapper class plan-billing--pricing) so it is consistent cross-page.
Keep the plan-card grid stable and legible at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile: no horizontal overflow, no overlapping/shingled cards, no dark-on-dark price text.

Preserve the existing hero, Main Features Of Play, Awesome Pricing Plan copy, Our Creative Team, Contact section, Blog route, Sign In, Sign Up, local logo/hero/team assets and the mobile navbar toggler; implement in source HTML/CSS/JS only.
design_constraints: Use the current Play visual language: blue primary accent, white/light-gray SaaS cards, rounded panels with restrained shadows, Inter typography and a spacious container width.
The billing toggle is a rounded pill control that sits inside the existing pricing section header area, not a bolted-on floating widget or second hero.
The billing control must render on the pricing section on every page that shows it (home and pricing page), so the cross-page pricing experience stays consistent.
Desktop keeps the three-column plan grid; tablet and 390px mobile stack the toggle and cards cleanly without horizontal overflow, overlap or clipped price labels.
Keep pricing.html, contact.html, the theme switcher and #navbarToggler behavior available as regression anchors.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, mobile_initial and tablet_initial capture the preserved Play homepage hero, navigation, feature/pricing/team/contact sections and mobile shell without horizontal overflow.

desktop_pricing_default and mobile_pricing_default capture the Awesome Pricing Plan section with the new billing toggle above the three plan cards, the readout reading 'Billing: Monthly · pay as you go', and a stable legible card grid with no overflow.
desktop_pricing_yearly captures the pricing section after clicking Yearly: the Yearly pill is active, the readout reads 'Billing: Yearly · save 20%' and the plan amounts show annual prices.
desktop_pricing_page and mobile_pricing_page capture the dedicated pricing page and must show the SAME billing control (plan-billing--pricing) on its pricing section.
mobile_nav_open captures the mobile navbar toggler open state as a regression anchor.

change_completion: The pricing section renders a Monthly / Yearly billing toggle above the three plan cards with a readout that reads 'Billing: Monthly · pay as you go' by default.
Clicking Yearly updates the readout to 'Billing: Yearly · save 20%' and swaps the plan amounts to their annual prices; clicking Monthly restores them.
design_consistency: The SAME billing control renders on the pricing section on BOTH the home page (plan-billing--home) and the pricing page (plan-billing--pricing).
The toggle matches the Play blue-accent SaaS design system (rounded pill, restrained shadows, Inter typography) and reads as part of the existing pricing section, not a detached widget.
regression: The homepage keeps its hero, Main Features Of Play, Awesome Pricing Plan copy, Our Creative Team, Contact section, Blog route, Sign In and Sign Up.
The shared navbar, theme switcher and #navbarToggler behavior continue to work across pages.
responsive: Home and pricing pages render without horizontal overflow at desktop, tablet and 390px mobile widths.
The plan-card grid stays legible and non-overlapping on tablet and mobile; price text keeps sufficient contrast (no dark-on-dark).

metadata.design_goal: keep a shared, interactive pricing control consistent across pages while wiring its billing-period interaction correctly
metadata.source_repo_kind: Static Tailwind SaaS marketing template with a shared navbar/footer design system, homepage sections, pricing/about/contact/blog/signin/signup routes, local assets, dark mode and a responsive navbar.

author_notes: L4 rebuild of the Play Tailwind (TailGrids play-tailwind) marketing site to a native genre lever: the site's OWN Awesome Pricing Plan section gains a Monthly/Yearly billing-period toggle placed above the three plan cards, with a live readout and prices that switch between monthly and annual figures. The reference renders the control on the pricing section on both the home page (plan-billing--home) and the pricing page (plan-billing--pricing), wires the toggle live, keeps the card grid legible and overflow-free, and preserves the hero, feature/team/contact sections, Blog, Sign In and Sign Up plus the local logo, hero image and team images. The baseline reproduces a layout defect (a fixed-width nowrap toggle row that overflows on mobile and a collapsed plan-card grid whose cards shingle over each other with negative margins and dark-on-dark price text) and renders the control on the home page only, but its toggle JavaScript is correct so the interaction still resolves. The smart-wrong bad leg carries the same broken layout and home-only control AND snapshots the readout string into a stale closure so clicking Yearly moves the pill and swaps amounts but never rewrites the readout. INFRA identical across all three legs: the template's inline scroll-spy read offsetTop of missing anchors (a pre-existing null throw on the homepage), guarded so the reference is console-clean; and section#pricing overflow is set visible so the real horizontal overflow is measurable. The lever uses a dedicated plan-billing.css/js (not Tailwind JIT) so the prebuilt tailwind.css is untouched. Assets referenced: assets/images/logo/logo.svg, hero image and team images render as the responsive design anchors.
